nom: Cell Fusion C Aquatica UV Defense Sunscreen SPF 50

avis.texte: I hated using sunscreen, I've tried many many sunscreens and they all left to some extent white cast, all felt greasy and oily. I also always hated that specific smell all sunscreens have. This is the sunscreen, that made me start wearing sunscreen!! It feels light on skin, absolutly no white cast and no strong smell. I absolutly love it. First time I liked sunscreen enough to repurchase. So happy I found it!
